::: {.reading}
I am Mikhael Manurung, an immunologist and computational biologist at Leiden University Medical Center. I investigate immune variation across populations, with an interest in how environmental exposures and infection history influence responses to infection and vaccination.

My work combines cytometry, single-cell profiling and computational analysis. Alongside experimental research, I develop open-source tools to make scientific analyses more interpretable and reproducible.

I trained in medicine and completed my PhD in Immunology at Leiden University Medical Center in June 2025. I welcome conversations about population immunology, single-cell methods and reproducible scientific software.
